items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Kaiser Marshall ... I don't know if he had a bass or not. I remember those three.

ctx.x: He had about 4 pieces in Atlanta. That's the first time I ever heard him play - Fletcher Henderson. ... Kaiser Marshall ... I don't know if he had a bass or not. I remember those three.
